If you're an AZADEA employee relocating to another country, you're generally eligible for a relocation allowance. This is typically a one-time payment, calculated as a percentage of your new basic salary, and it's paid in the currency of your destination country. The allowance is usually processed within 3 working days. Just a quick note—if this is your second relocation within the same year, you'll only receive the full allowance if the move is at the company's request.
